reviews.reasons: CONDITIONAL is now the right stance: price, close rate, fulfiller terms and payout time are all unknown (card facts are RECOMMENDATION; verified research found no buyer-paid price for this population) and each is measured by a zero-cost first phase with explicit proof, stop and continue rules before any money moves. Limits: no capital is ever advanced (freelancer ordered on day 9 from cash settled on day 8; maxExposure 0), no owner work (every step is Brain's or the freelancer's), and the timeline fits: offer day 2, prepay by day 5, payout <= 3 days -> day 8, 5-day build -> day 14. Recomputed: 5 x $500 = $2,500 settled in window >= $1,500; minus 5 x $150 = $750 freelancer cost -> $1,750 kept, so the target holds even on a net reading. The stop rules refund any prepayment and stop at zero spend if a term fails.
findings: Settled $2,500 by day 8; freelancer $750 from settled funds on day 9; net $1,750.

Zero slack on delivery: builds ordered day 9 with a 5-day bound end on day 14; a late or failed build after cash settled means a refund obligation. The freelancer quote in r1 should carry the delivery date and a fallback freelancer.
Stop at fewer than 5 prepaid is stricter than needed for gross settled cash (3 x $500 = $1,500); this is conservative, not a defect.
The payment route must land in an account the owner already holds, since the owner does no work; SEND_A_MESSAGE must be connected by day 2 (it is a stop rule).

steps.label: Brain confirms in writing with at least 2 Fiverr web-design freelancers a fixed price <= $150 and <= 5-day delivery for a 5-page small-business site, ordered only after the buyer's money has settled
Brain confirms the payout time of the payment route (payment link / bank transfer into the owner's existing account) in writing: days from buyer payment to usable cash
Brain emails 150 local service businesses without a website (public map listings) offering a 5-page site for $500, paid in full up front, built within 5 days of settlement
Brain answers replies and sends payment links; 5 businesses prepay $500 by day 5
5 prepayments settle into the owner's account (payout <= 3 days, per r2)
Fiverr freelancer builds and hands over the 5 sites (5 x $150 order paid from settled prepayments), delivered by day 14

cash.label: 5 freelancer builds at $150, paid from settled cash

quantities.name: price local businesses without a website pay for a 5-page site
close rate of the cold offer
freelancer price per build
payout time of the payment route

validation.proof: By day 5: Brain's sending is connected (day 2); r1 has a written freelancer quote <= $150 with <= 5-day delivery; r2 confirms payout <= 3 days; and 5 businesses have prepaid $500 each.
stop: Brain's outbound sending is not connected by day 2
no freelancer confirms <= $150 and <= 5-day delivery by day 2
payout time of the payment route is > 3 days
fewer than 5 prepaid sales by day 5 (refund any prepayment received and stop; nothing has been spent)
continue: 5 prepaid by day 5 with all terms confirmed: let cash settle (day 8), order the 5 builds from settled cash (day 9), deliver by day 14

answers.finding: Re-state as CONDITIONAL with the same zero-cost test, or name an evidenced constraint; missing evidence is not a constraint.
answers.resolution: Accepted: restated as CONDITIONAL with the zero-cost test as its first phase (r1, r2, s1, s2) and explicit proof/stop/continue.

answers.finding: Timeline: day 7 acceptance + 5-day build + payout <= 5 days = day 17; the payout threshold must be <= 2 days, or acceptances must land by ~day 5, for $1,500 to settle by day 14.
answers.resolution: Accepted: buyers now prepay in full by day 5, so settlement no longer waits for the build; proof requires payout <= 3 days (r2), so cash settles by day 8, well inside day 14. The build is ordered on day 9 from settled cash and does not gate settlement.

answers.finding: Proof needs >= 3 written acceptances at $500 (3 x $500 = $1,500 exactly, zero margin for a refund or a no-pay) but stop fires only below 1; 1-2 acceptances is undefined. Either proof must require more than 3, or the stop must be below 3.
answers.resolution: Accepted: the plan now needs 5 prepaid sales ($2,500 gross, $1,750 after $750 of builds) and stop fires at anything below 5 prepaid by day 5, so there is no undefined band.

answers.finding: Settled cash target is gross; the $150 freelancer fee per site paid after settlement is consistent with $0 capital only if the fulfiller agrees in writing (r1), which the proof correctly requires.
answers.resolution: Accepted: no net terms are needed now; the freelancer is ordered and paid only after the buyers' prepayments settle, which keeps owner exposure at $0. r1 must confirm the price and delivery in writing.

answers.finding: SEND_A_MESSAGE is NOT_CONNECTED for t1; the plan's day-2 send depends on it.
answers.resolution: Accepted: sending is not connected. Validation now stops the plan if Brain's outbound sending cannot be connected by day 2; the owner's only role is authorizing that connection, which needs no work beyond authority he alone holds.

review.reasons: CONDITIONAL is now the right stance: price, close rate, fulfiller terms and payout time are all unknown (card facts are RECOMMENDATION; verified research found no buyer-paid price for this population) and each is measured by a zero-cost first phase with explicit proof, stop and continue rules before any money moves. Limits: no capital is ever advanced (freelancer ordered on day 9 from cash settled on day 8; maxExposure 0), no owner work (every step is Brain's or the freelancer's), and the timeline fits: offer day 2, prepay by day 5, payout <= 3 days -> day 8, 5-day build -> day 14. Recomputed: 5 x $500 = $2,500 settled in window >= $1,500; minus 5 x $150 = $750 freelancer cost -> $1,750 kept, so the target holds even on a net reading. The stop rules refund any prepayment and stop at zero spend if a term fails.
findings: Settled $2,500 by day 8; freelancer $750 from settled funds on day 9; net $1,750.

If the payment route is a card payment link, fees (~2.9% + $0.30 = $14.80 x 5 = $74) are missing from the ledger; net would be $1,676, still above target. r2 should record the fee with the payout time.

Zero slack on delivery: builds ordered day 9 with a 5-day bound end on day 14; a late or failed build after cash settled means a refund obligation. The freelancer quote in r1 should carry the delivery date and a fallback freelancer.
Stop at fewer than 5 prepaid is stricter than needed for gross settled cash (3 x $500 = $1,500); this is conservative, not a defect.
The payment route must land in an account the owner already holds, since the owner does no work; SEND_A_MESSAGE must be connected by day 2 (it is a stop rule).
